title: Focus Crossroads Acquires Zintro's B2B Expert Network and Concierge Program
summary: Focus Crossroads, a US firm that recruits participants for qualitative and quantitative research, acquired several assets from Zintro, including its B2B network and its Concierge Program, which provides vetted subject matter experts for complex research projects. Research Live reported the network at about 130,000 verified professionals, roughly 50,000 of them senior executives. The deal value was not disclosed. Focus Crossroads vice-president Greg Caruncho said the purchase significantly expands the firm's ability to support specialized B2B, healthcare, and professional audience research.
whyItMatters: A market-research recruiter buying a self-service expert network's assets continues the convergence of expert networks and B2B research panels.
